# The Anatolian Journal of Cardiology

> A peer-reviewed Turkish cardiology journal with Impact Factor 1.5, publishing original research, editorials, and clinical studies on cardiovascular disease and related conditions.

The Anatolian Journal of Cardiology is an open-access, peer-reviewed publication affiliated with the Turkish Society of Cardiology and indexed in PubMed. Based in Istanbul and led by Editor-in-Chief Çetin Erol, the journal publishes cutting-edge cardiology research including clinical trials, diagnostic studies, and pharmacovigilance analyses.

## Key Topics

- Cardiology
- Cardiovascular Risk
- Heart Failure
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Hypertension
- Coronary Artery Disease
- Stroke Risk
- TyG Index
- PCSK9 Inhibitors
- Direct Oral Anticoagulants
- Peer Review
- Clinical Research
- Turkish Society of Cardiology
- Impact Factor
- Manuscript Submission

## Current Research & Publications

- [Ahead Of Print The Anatolian Journal of Cardiology](https://anatoljcardiol.com/ahead-of-print): Ahead-of-print cardiology research including letters, investigations, and editorials
- [TyG Index, BRI/TSH ratio, NPAR ratio, TAPSE/ PASP ratio…](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-05126): Editorial on clinical markers including TyG index and heart failure risk assessment
- [Pathophysiological Insights and Prognostic Value of the Triglyceride-Glucose Index](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-87856): Research on triglyceride-glucose index as prognostic marker in chronic total occlusion
- [PCSK9 Inhibition Protects Against Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-27185): Animal study on PCSK9 inhibitor alirocumab for cardioprotection in type 2 diabetes
- [Integrating Thyroid Function with Body Composition: The BRITSH Ratio](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-59296): Pilot study on BRITSH ratio linking thyroid function and body composition to cardiovascular risk
- [Thrombotic and Hemorrhagic Adverse Events of Direct Oral Anticoagulants](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-67387): Pharmacovigilance analysis of sex-related differences in direct oral anticoagulant adverse events
- [Neutrophil Percentage-to-Albumin Ratio as Novel Predictor of Diuretic Resistance](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-65943): Clinical research on neutrophil-albumin ratio predicting diuretic resistance in heart failure
- [The Hidden Burden of COMISA in Hypertensive Obstructive Sleep Apnea Patients](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-95878): Clinical study on comorbid insomnia and sleep apnea in resistant hypertension patients
- [Postoperative Right Ventriculo-Pulmonary Artery Coupling as Predictor After TAVI](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-32602): TAVI outcomes research using TAPSE/PASP ratio for long-term prognostic assessment

## Letters & Correspondence

- [Comments on Nonsustained Atrial Fibrillation and Stroke Risk](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-03257): Letter to editor critiquing methodological considerations in atrial fibrillation stroke risk study
- [Reply to Letter to the Editor on Nonsustained Atrial Fibrillation and Stroke Risk](https://anatoljcardiol.com/article/AJC-15237): Author response letter addressing methodological critiques on atrial fibrillation stroke risk
